{{Quote|Stay strong, Tilden Kaah. With your help&mdash;and the help of all of us here&mdash;the Keshiri will finish the job.|Adari Vaal|<ref name="paragon" />}}
'''Tilden Kaah''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Kaah worked as the personal [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Seelah Korsin]], a member of a group of crash-landed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who assumed the position of rulers of the world after their arrival in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. However, Kaah was secretly a well-respected scholar working as an agent for a [[Keshiri resistance]] group who were actively working to overthrow the Sith government, and evaded the suspicions of Seelah and her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], Sith leader [[Yaru Korsin]], by pretending to be a superstitious simpleton.

In [[4985 BBY]], Kaah informed his resistance superiors of the [[Red Sith Purge|purge]] of dozens of members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], after the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of thousands of Keshiri due to the [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] of several [[Water/Legends|water]] supplies by a trusted [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] of Yaru Korsin, [[Ravilan Wroth]]. After that incident, Kaah continued his work with the Keshiri resistance until the group's collapse in [[4975 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Double agent===
{{Quote|I didn't mean to turn this into a working day so early. Forgive me. Were you finished bathing? I could have the minders recycle the water.|Tilden Kaah attends to Seelah Korsin|<ref name="paragon" />}}
[[File:Lost_Sith_Tribe_world.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tilden Kaah lived on the planet Kesh (pictured).]]
Tilden Kaah was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]],<ref name="paragon" /> a world that in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] was visited by a group of crash-landed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] claiming to be the Keshiri [[Deity/Legends|gods]], the [[Skyborn]].<ref name="skyborn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref> The Keshiri masses wholeheartedly believed the Sith, and the newcomers took their place as rulers of the planet; by [[4985 BBY]], Tilden Kaah was working as the attendant to [[Seelah Korsin]], [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] to Sith leader [[Yaru Korsin]]. Kaah, a well-respected scholar, hid his intellect from Korsin to further his work as a [[Spy/Legends|covert agent]] of a [[Keshiri resistance]] group opposed to the rule of the Sith. Kaah followed Korsin everywhere she went, and was responsible for the management of her day-to-day activities, which he relayed back to the resistance effort alongside information about other Sith. Although Kaah was a scholar, he played the part of superstitious fool in front of Korsin, lulling her into believing him not to be a threat.<ref name="paragon" />

By 4985 BBY, Yaru Korsin had begun to spend a considerable amount of [[Time/Legends|time]] with [[Adari Vaal]], the individual who first discovered the Sith fifteen years earlier and a secret leader of the Keshiri resistance, and Seelah enlisted Kaah to spy on them. Kaah would follow them when they were on walks together, and would report back to Seelah periodically with his findings.<ref name="paragon" />

One [[Standard day/Legends|day]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Kaah approached Seelah in her residence at the [[Kesh Sith Temple]] after she caught him watching her shower in the bathroom. Seelah believed that Kaah frequently stared at and spied on her from just out of view because he was attracted to and had a religious obsession with her, completely unaware he was a spy. Kaah subsequently rattled off her schedule for the day, which included meeting with [[Ravilan Wroth]], a trusted [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] for Yaru Korsin, who he called the "crimson man" because he was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. When she decided to head out immediately, Kaah apologized for starting the day's work early and helped her put on her shoes, though Seelah insisted she was happy to start working. At Kaah's mention, however, she did request for him to have the water deliveries sped up and brought from a different location. Later that day, Kaah spied on Vaal and Korsin and reported back to Seelah that they were together all afternoon.<ref name="paragon" />

===Double massacres===
{{Quote|It is done. Seelah has rid the Skyborn of the Fifty-seven. Of the people like them, only the bumpy man, Gloyd, remains.|Tilden Kaah, reporting on the deaths of Ravilan Wroth and his compatriots to the Keshiri resistance|<ref name="paragon" />}}
[[File:Adari_Vaal.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tilden Kaah secretly worked for Adari Vaal (pictured) and her Keshiri resistance.]]
Just before dusk, Kaah joined Seelah at the temple to visit Yaru, who was staring at a glass statue of himself made by the Keshiri. Kaah insisted the statue was beautiful and worthy of the Skyborn, before correcting himself and calling them the protectors. There, Seelah and Yaru received word that the population of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tetsubal]] mysteriously [[Death/Legends|died]] under unusual circumstances, and that the only survivor was Wroth, who had been visiting several towns in the area. Eventually, Seelah deduced that Wroth himself caused the mysterious plague that ravaged Tetsubal, and subsequently several other settlements, by [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] local [[Water/Legends|water]] supplies with [[cyanogen silicate]]. In convincing Yaru Korsin of her findings, Seelah called for a nervous Kaah to bring him a container of the chemical.<ref name="paragon" />

As a result of the incident, Ravilan Wroth and the other members of the Sith species who remained from the Sith's initial crash were [[Red Sith Purge|wiped out]], leaving the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Gloyd]] the only surviving [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] Sith. After the [[Speciecide|purge]], Kaah traveled through the streets of the city [[Tahv]] to a secret Keshiri resistance meeting place hidden behind a flow of water from an aqueduct in a plaza. Hearing those gathered discuss what they had heard of the disaster in Tetsubal as he approached, Kaash revealed the news and details of the purge of the Sith to Adari Vaal and other high-ranking members of the resistance. After he assured them all that Seelah did not suspect him, Vaal commended him and insisted that all of them together would be able to take down the Sith rulers.<ref name="paragon" /> Kaah continued his work for the resistance for the next ten years, until the collapse of the Keshiri resistance in [[4975 BBY]].<ref name="savior">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|She can't tell our great scholars from our fools.|A member of the Keshiri resistance on Seelah Korsin and Tilden Kaah|<ref name="paragon" />}}
Tilden Kaah was a well-respected scholar who was very cunning, allowing him to completely disguise his work for the Keshiri resistance from the likes of the Korsins. Kaah had purple skin, opal, [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and white [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="paragon" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Seelah doesn't suspect you? She doesn't ''read your mind''?''"<br />"''She doesn't think I'm worth it. And I speak of nothing but the old legends. She thinks me a fool.|Adari Vaal and Tilden Kaah|<ref name="paragon" />}}
He was an able spy, not only keeping track of Seelah Korsin's activities for the resistance, but also keeping watch over the interactions between Yaru Korsin and Adari Vaal at Seelah's behest. He deftly played the role of the fool, making sure to play up a superstitious belief in the divinity of the Sith. However, he frequently watched Seelah in the mornings as she showered, and whenever he watched her from just out of view, he never remembered that she could [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] his presence through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="paragon" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Oh, and the ''crimson man'' has asked for an audience.|Kaah to Seelah Korsin, after checking his notes|<ref name="paragon" />}}
Kaah carried notes to keep track of Seelah Korsin's schedule. He wore a hooded robe while meeting with the Keshiri resistance.<ref name="paragon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tilden Kaah first appeared in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2009]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''.<ref name="paragon" />
